aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: We build Firmspace AI ourselves and use it in our own day-to-day work.

stepContentFirst.step1: Click on the `Sign Up` or `Create Account` button on our homepage. Fill out the registration form with your details. Make sure to provide accurate information. Choose a unique username and a strong password. Your username will be your identity on our platform, so pick something memorable.
stepContentFirst.step2: `Access the dashboard` is your gateway to a world of possibilities within our platform. Once you log in, you'll find yourself in a centralized hub where you can navigate, manage, and explore all the features, tools, and information at your fingertips. From tracking your progress, connecting with others, to accessing resources, the dashboard is your control center for a seamless and productive experience.
stepContentFirst.step3: Tasks are a powerful tool for managing your to-do list and staying organized. To create a task, access your dashboard and locate the `Tasks` or `To-Do List` section. Click on the `Create Task` button. Fill in the task details, including a title, description, due date, and any relevant tags or categories. You can also set priority levels to help you prioritize your tasks. Once you've filled out the information, click `Save` or `Create` to add the task to your list. You can easily edit, mark as complete, or delete tasks as needed.
stepContentFirst.step4: Dive into the world of possibilities and features our application offers and relish the convenience it brings to your digital life.

stepContentSecond.step1: When you return to the platform in the future, simply click on the `Sign In` button. Enter your username and password. Click `Sign In` and you'll have access to your account
stepContentSecond.step2: When you `Access the dashboard` you open the door to a personalized experience tailored to your needs. This dynamic interface serves as your command center, offering real-time insights, notifications, and easy access to essential functions. Whether you're monitoring your account, customizing settings, or diving into your latest projects, the dashboard provides a user-friendly, intuitive hub for all your interactions within our platform.
stepContentSecond.step3: The feed is your source for the latest updates, news, and posts from other users or relevant information on our platform. To access the feed, click on the `Feed` or `News` section in your dashboard. Scroll through the feed to view posts, articles, and updates from your connections or relevant sources. You can like, comment, and share posts to engage with the community. Use filters or search options to narrow down the content you're interested in. Stay informed and connected by regularly checking the feed for valuable insights and updates.
stepContentSecond.step4: We've crafted this application with your enjoyment in mind, so take full advantage of its offerings and make your experience unforgettable.

whatIsCrm.defaultTextFirst: Firmspace AI is a CRM for small and mid-sized companies: customers and sales, team communication, projects, accounting and reporting in one application. Data is separated per company and access is controlled by roles.
whatIsCrm.defaultTextSecond: Instead of several separate tools, every area works on the same data. A sale shows up on the dashboard immediately, an overdue invoice triggers a rule, and the AI assistant answers questions about customers, tasks and documents.

settings.intTwilioAuto: Incoming SMS and calls are set up automatically. Calls from the browser need HTTPS and access to the microphone.
settings.intHelp_twilio: Enter your Twilio Account SID and Auth Token (console.twilio.com) and one of your Twilio numbers. The CRM configures the number and creates the keys for browser calls itself.
settings.intHelp_vonage: Vonage sends with the API key and API secret from your Vonage account. The sender can be a name (for example Firmspace) or a number approved by Vonage.
settings.intHelp_plivo: Plivo: the Auth ID and Auth Token from your Plivo account. The sender is a number you bought at Plivo.
settings.intHelp_telnyx: Telnyx: the API key from your Telnyx account. The sender is a number from the same account.
settings.intSmsInboundNote: Incoming SMS are accepted for Twilio only for now — with the other providers, sending works for the time being.
settings.intHelp_sip: Connect any SIP provider or PBX that supports SIP over WebSocket (wss://): Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, 3CX, FusionPBX and many cloud PBXs. Ask your provider for the WebSocket server address, SIP domain, username and password. The browser registers with the provider itself, so the CRM checks the login before saving.
settings.intChooseProviderSms: Choose your provider. If it is not in the list, let us know — we will add it.
settings.intChooseProvider: Choose your provider. If it is not in the list, pick “Other provider (manual)”: any operator or PBX with SIP over WebSocket (wss://) works.
settings.provHelp_telnyx: Telnyx: in the Telnyx Portal create a SIP connection with credentials and enter its username and password. The server address comes from the Telnyx documentation; we have not yet tested it on a live Telnyx account.
settings.provHelp_asterisk: Asterisk, FreePBX or Issabel on your server: enable WebRTC (WSS) for the extension. Enter the WebSocket address (Asterisk default: wss://your-server:8089/ws), the server domain, and the extension number with its password.
settings.provHelp_freeswitch: FreeSWITCH on your server: enable WSS (default port 7443). Enter the WebSocket address, the FreeSWITCH domain, and the user number with its password.
settings.intSipReplaces: This replaces your current SIP connection ({name}).
settings.intSipConnected: Calls are made and received in the browser through this provider, and every call is recorded in the CRM. Incoming calls ring only while a CRM tab is open.
settings.intHelp_telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token. People write to the bot, and the messages appear in Chat and Calls.
settings.intHelp_viber: Create a bot account at partners.viber.com and paste its authentication token. The webhook is registered automatically.
settings.intHelp_messenger: In Meta for Developers create an app with the Messenger product. Paste the Page access token of your page (Meta shows user and app tokens right next to it — they will not work) and the App secret. Then add your page under Messenger → Add or Remove Pages — this is what subscribes it to events — and enter Callback URL and Verify token (shown after connecting) into the app's Webhooks settings, subscribing to «messages». Without the subscription messages do not arrive.
settings.intHelp_whatsapp: In Meta for Developers create an app with the WhatsApp product and a test or business number, then paste the Phone number ID, the permanent Access token and the App secret. The number answers messages from the platform right after connecting.
settings.intWaWebhookHelp: Enter the Callback URL and the Verify token above in the app's WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhooks, subscribe to the «messages» field — after that incoming messages appear in Chat and Calls.
settings.intHelp_webchat: A chat bubble for your website. Visitors write from the site, and you answer in Chat and Calls.
settings.intPollingInfo: Local mode: new messages are fetched while Chat and Calls is open. On a public https address the site switches to webhooks.
settings.intErrNeedHttps: Webhooks need a public https address. Set APP_URL (or open the site on its public domain), then press «Register webhook».

settings.irisHelp: A separate bot for Iris (create it with @BotFather, give it her picture) — not the bot that sends notifications. Open her profile in Telegram and write or send a voice message: Iris does it in the CRM and replies in the chat. Only the chat you find below is accepted, actions run with your rights. Several tasks in one message run one by one; deleting and anything after reading e-mails asks «yes/no» first.
settings.agentsHelp: Platform administrators only. An external agent (for example in DeepSeek Harness) that writes articles for the landing blog: its own token with the “Blog” permission only — read articles and save drafts. The token is written to the agent’s file automatically. Agents that work with your firm’s data connect with the key above (“Connect an agent or bot”).

admin.denied: This section is for the platform administrator only.

admin.ordersHelp: When the money has arrived on the account or wallet, press “Confirm payment” — the plan switches on for a month or a year (renewals count from the end of the current term).

capabilities.title: What Firmspace AI actually does
capabilities.subtitle: No claims — just the features you will use after signing in.
capabilities.crm_text: Contacts, companies and a sales pipeline as a board or a list. Activities, notes and tasks stay attached to each deal.
capabilities.collab_text: Feed, chat and calling, calendar, online documents and mailboxes — connected to Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp and your e-mail account.
capabilities.automation_text: Rules react to events such as an order being created or an invoice falling due, and trigger a notification, task, e-mail or webhook.
capabilities.finance_text: Quotes, orders, invoices, expenses and stock. Documents as PDF, with a payment QR code and direct delivery to the customer.
capabilities.analytics_text: A dashboard with tasks, closed deals and period comparison; figures for revenue, outstanding amounts and ad channels.
capabilities.security_text: Several companies per account, roles with module permissions, data separated per organisation and a log of every change.

office.title: Robot Office
office.subtitle: Your team of robots: each one handles its part of the work, Iris hands out the tasks.
office.bossHint: Give a task — Iris will split it between the robots.
office.bossPlaceholder: For example: prepare reminders for overdue invoices and check the stock
office.boardEmpty: No tasks yet. Pick a robot and give it a task, or tell Iris.
office.dragHint: Drag a robot to another room, and a task or a file onto a robot.
office.emptyOffice: Nobody works here yet. Hire robots from the catalog or create your own.
office.notConfigured: AI is not set up on this site yet — the robots cannot work.
office.loadFailed: The office could not be loaded
office.autonomyHint: «Asks» — changes to data wait for your confirmation. «Acts on its own» — the robot does them right away; deletions always ask.
office.routinesEmpty: None. Add a task the robot will do by itself on a schedule.
office.dismissText: The robot leaves the office and its queue is cancelled. The history of finished tasks stays.
office.hireHint: Pick a ready-made robot or create your own — for any kind of business.
office.customHint: Describe the role and choose what it can do. It deletes nothing — robots cannot delete.
office.fInstructionsPh: What exactly this robot does and how: rules, tone, limits
office.needTitle: Give a job title or instructions
office.fileTooBig: The file is too large (up to 40 KB of text)
office.fileNotText: Only text files are read (txt, csv, md, json)
office.fileTask: Process this file «{name}» according to your role:
office.tpl_sales_desc: Keeps leads and deals moving, follows up with customers, prepares quotes.
office.tpl_sales_s1: Show the open deals and what to do next with each
office.tpl_sales_s2: Find customers nobody has contacted for a while and create call tasks
office.tpl_sales_s3: Prepare a quote for the hottest deal
office.tpl_orders_desc: Takes a customer from quote to order, invoice and contract.
office.tpl_orders_s1: Turn all accepted quotes into orders
office.tpl_orders_s2: Create invoices for all completed orders
office.tpl_orders_s3: Show orders that are stuck and what to do about them
office.tpl_accounting_desc: Invoices, expenses and payments: creates, records, reconciles and sums up.
office.tpl_accounting_s1: Show this month's summary: revenue, expenses, open amounts
office.tpl_accounting_s2: Find unpaid invoices and tell me which ones are already paid
office.tpl_accounting_s3: Record the expenses from this description and prepare a draft invoice
office.tpl_dunning_desc: Finds overdue invoices and prepares polite payment reminders.
office.tpl_dunning_s1: Find overdue invoices and prepare reminders — do not send yet
office.tpl_dunning_s2: Send the first reminder to customers up to 14 days overdue
office.tpl_dunning_s3: Make a list of debtors by amount and age of the debt
office.tpl_controlling_desc: Does the numbers: revenue, expenses, profit, stock and production; e-mails reports.
office.tpl_controlling_s1: Compare this month with the last one and explain the difference
office.tpl_controlling_s2: E-mail me a report on overdue invoices
office.tpl_controlling_s3: What eats the most profit this quarter?
office.tpl_warehouse_desc: Watches stock levels, books goods in, prepares what to re-order.
office.tpl_warehouse_s1: What is running out? Make a re-order list
office.tpl_warehouse_s2: Book 50 units of an item into the main warehouse
office.tpl_warehouse_s3: Show items without movement in recent months
office.tpl_purchasing_desc: Suppliers, purchase orders, receiving goods and paying supplier invoices.
office.tpl_purchasing_s1: Prepare a purchase for the items running low
office.tpl_purchasing_s2: Show supplier invoices due this week
office.tpl_purchasing_s3: Receive the delivery for the open purchase order
office.tpl_production_desc: Specifications, production orders, material write-off and finished goods.
office.tpl_production_s1: How much material do the open orders need?
office.tpl_production_s2: Make 10 pieces and put them on stock
office.tpl_production_s3: Show the production orders and their status
office.tpl_tasks_desc: Keeps tasks and deadlines in check, plans the day, creates reminders.
office.tpl_tasks_s1: Make today's plan from my tasks
office.tpl_tasks_s2: Show overdue tasks and suggest new deadlines
office.tpl_tasks_s3: Create tasks from this list and set deadlines
office.tpl_mail_desc: Sorts incoming mail, picks out what matters, creates tasks and drafts replies.
office.tpl_mail_s1: Sort the new mail: what matters and what does not
office.tpl_mail_s3: Create tasks for mails waiting for an answer
office.tpl_hr_desc: Employee records, employment contracts, reminders for key dates.
office.tpl_hr_s1: Show employees and who has no contract
office.tpl_hr_s2: Remind me about probation periods ending
office.tpl_hr_s3: Attach the contract to the employee
office.tpl_marketing_desc: Ideas, blog and newsletter texts, target groups from your contacts.
office.tpl_marketing_s1: Suggest 5 blog topics, considering what is already published
office.tpl_marketing_s2: Write a draft newsletter for customers
office.tpl_marketing_s3: Pick a contact list for the campaign
office.tpl_support_desc: Customer summaries, open issues, reply drafts and follow-up tasks.
office.tpl_support_s1: Summarize the history with this customer
office.tpl_support_s3: Prepare a reply to the latest complaint
office.fInstructionsDefault: Leave empty — the robot works by the standard catalog instructions.
